description: A RepoMind triage plan: the ordered list of steps to run.

steps.description: The steps, in the order they run. The last step must call post_comment.

action.description: What the step does, in words.

tool.description: The one tool this step calls; must be in the tool list.

args_json.description: The tool's arguments as a JSON object encoded as a string. Use "$fill" for any value that depends on an earlier step's result.

depends_on.description: Ids of earlier steps whose results this step uses.

expected_result.description: What the tool returns when the step worked, so success can be observed.

status.description: Execution status; the planner writes pending.
